categories.label: Faster storage
categories.summary: The slow hard disk is the main thing holding this laptop back.

options.title: Swap the hard disk for a 500 GB SSD
options.reason: The M.2 slot takes an NVMe SSD, which is much faster than the old hard disk.
options.why: Office work mostly waits on the drive. An SSD in the free M.2 slot removes that wait, and the old disk can stay as extra storage.

claims.text: The laptop has one M.2 2280 slot for NVMe or SATA SSDs.

options.title: Reinstall the operating system
options.reason: A fresh install can remove years of clutter, but it does not fix a slow disk.
options.why: Only worth it if the laptop is slow because of old software. Back up your files first.

categories.label: Memory
categories.summary: A second memory module doubles the RAM for many browser tabs.

options.title: Add an 8 GB DDR4 module
options.reason: One of the two SO-DIMM slots is free.
options.why: 8 GB gets tight with many tabs and video calls. The free slot takes a second module without removing the first.

claims.text: The computer has two SO-DIMM DDR4 slots and supports up to 32 GB.

categories.label: Battery
categories.summary: The battery holds 72% of its design capacity.

options.title: Replace the battery
options.reason: The manual calls the battery customer-replaceable, held by two screws.
options.why: A worn battery shortens time away from the charger. The manual allows the owner to swap it.

claims.text: The battery is a customer-replaceable unit secured by two screws.

categories.label: Graphics
categories.summary: The graphics are built into the processor.

options.title: Add a graphics card
options.reason: Laptops of this kind have no slot for a graphics card.
options.why: An external graphics enclosure would cost more than the laptop is worth.

categories.label: Hand it down
categories.summary: Someone else can keep using it once your data is erased.

options.title: Give it to someone who needs a laptop
options.reason: It still runs a supported operating system and works for office tasks.
options.why: Passing it on keeps it in use. Reset it and erase the drive before handing it over.

claims.text: Reset the operating system and securely erase all drives before passing it on.

options.title: Bring it to an e-waste collection point
options.reason: Certified collection recovers the materials once the laptop is no longer used.
options.why: This is the right end only when nobody can use the laptop any more.
